name: OHM
recent: OHM 于 2026 年 11 月 25 日召开第三次常年股东大会，所有决议均获股东通过；同日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止第一季度业绩。董事会出现多项人事变动，涉及提名委员会、薪酬委员会、审计委员会及董事部。
notable: 第三次常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 25 日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
董事会及多个委员会出现人事变动，涉及 MISS TAN MUI PING 与 MR CHEW PHAI HAU。
执行董事兼首席运营官 DATIN TANG JING WEN 于 2026 年 11 月 3 日增持 305,400 股普通股。
risks: 执行董事兼首席运营官 DATIN TANG JING WEN 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日发出在闭市期交易股份的意向通知。
执行董事兼首席执行官 DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日发出在闭市期交易股份的意向通知。

OTHERS

recent_en: OHM held its Third Annual General Meeting on 25 November 2026, where all resolutions were approved by shareholders; it also announced its first quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on the same day. Several board changes occurred, involving the Nomination Committee, Remuneration Committee, Audit Committee and Boardroom.
notable_en: The Third Annual General Meeting was held on 25 November 2026 and all resolutions were approved by shareholders.
Board and committee changes occurred, involving MISS TAN MUI PING and MR CHEW PHAI HAU.
Executive Director and Chief Operating Officer DATIN TANG JING WEN acquired 305,400 ordinary shares on 3 November 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director and Chief Operating Officer DATIN TANG JING WEN gave notice of intention to deal in securities during the closed period on 30 October 2026.
Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG gave notice of intention to deal in securities during the closed period on 30 October 2026.
